candidate: phase-expanded admittance-weighted block Laplacian of the IEEE PES European LV feeder, used as a spectral embedding, projected through the injections, with NO restriction to the predicted outputs
mechanism_statement: the k smallest eigenpairs of the grounded 2715x2715 complex-symmetric line-network block Laplacian, gathered at each load's own phase, act on the injection vector to produce a low-dimensional coordinate system; the claim is that this coordinate system is better aligned with the far-end voltage response than generic directions or a plain graph metric

survival.S3_downstream: not evaluated here; the per-fold measure and arrays are recorded so the downstream comparison can be made without re-running
survival.rule_note: the pre-registered ranking rule selected SP-R1a-GP-k11-S2 over the plan's frozen SP-R1a-GP-k11; both are reported, and the frozen cell is the one named in the pre-registration so no criterion is moved after the fact

coverage_arbiter.verdict: the predictive density is UNUSABLE: empirical coverage is 0.8% at the nominal 68% level and 1.6% at 95%, i.e. the intervals are overconfident by orders of magnitude
coverage_arbiter.cause: the tuning protocol drives the noise variance to the grid floor (n2 = 1e-8) because the output is a deterministic AC solve: the marginal likelihood and held-out error both reward interpolating every training point, which leaves no residual variance for the test rows. The POINT prediction is unaffected, but no downstream use may treat the GP variance as a confidence statement.
coverage_arbiter.nlpd_note: NLPD is reported but is not read as evidence in either direction: it becomes hugely negative when the density sharpens around a small-but-nonzero error, which is exactly the failure this run already caught once.

controls.reading: every control runs the identical GP protocol on 2k = 22 coordinates and changes only how the 55x11 block is chosen. The candidate beats a random block by 9.7x, a row-permutation of its own eigenvectors by 10.9x and the shuffled-phase gather by 12.8x. The shuffled-phase control is the one the original request names: when the loads' phase labels are permuted the construction loses most of its advantage, so the phase labels carry real information and the phase-aware claim is supported rather than incidental. The hop-count graph Laplacian and the injection PCA both land near the mean predictor, so neither graph structure without impedance nor generic compression reproduces it.

decomposition.reading: the wide-RBF GP at the selected lengthscale is a nonlinear interpolator. It improves on OLS by 4.17x on the spectral coordinates but by only 1.00x on PCA coordinates, so the learner is not the source of the margin by itself: it amplifies a signal that is already present. At the same learner the spectral coordinates are 42.0x better than the 22 PCA coordinates, and 10.1x better at the linear learner. The margin therefore traces to the feeder's own Laplacian spectrum, and the honest caveat is that the wide-RBF kernel is what converts a 10x coordinate advantage into a 40x error advantage, so both halves of the construction are load-bearing.

verdict: PASSES S1 and S2: SP-R1a-GP-k11-S2 beats the best per-fold baseline by +77.9% on the mean and +70.1% in its worst fold at n = 80

caveats.single_feeder: one 906-bus LV feeder. The construction is feeder-specific by design; the transferable quantities (effective rank, eigenvalue spectrum, principal angles) are reported so the mechanism could be tested elsewhere even though the accuracy is not.
caveats.synthetic_ensembles: ground truth is runpp_3ph under independent per-load lognormal multipliers on each load's real phase, not measured profiles. Real LV loads are correlated, which would make the injection distribution lower-dimensional and would generally help a low-rank kernel — so this departure plausibly flatters the candidate.
caveats.exact_network_parameters: sequence impedances and phase labels taken as known exactly; no parameter uncertainty, so nothing here says how the spectral construction degrades under parameter error.
caveats.reused_evidence: reserving seeds 12-29 reserves SPLITS and not data: the same 220 AC draws underlie every fold. The genuinely untouched evidence is the 2.6x regime and the moved-phase feeder, not the seed list. Realized folds are 24 at n<=80 and 12 at n=160, so the n=160 worst-fold statistic rests on 12 folds.
caveats.no_significance_testing: per-fold arrays are published so a later step can compute intervals without re-running; the pre-registered criterion is worst-case, which is stricter than a mean test.

ac_solve_cost.note: b5 needs ONE no-load runpp_3ph solve for its reference V0b and then propagates analytically; the 220 solves are the ground truth archive, shared by every arm and not attributable to any of them.

caveats.circularity: b3 (admittance multiphase Kirchhoff metric) is derived from the same block Laplacian the candidate's spectrum comes from and is therefore NOT an independent baseline. b1, b2, b4 and b5 are all constructible without that Laplacian or the treatment operator.
